userText:
Building: de Young Museum, San Francisco (museum).
The front (−z) is the entrance court on Music Concourse Drive.
Footprint: 157.2 m along x by 76.3 m along z, centred on the origin.
Outline (approximate: the hull of its OpenStreetMap parts), [x, z] in metres, going round:
[[-78.6,38.1],[-78.5,-38.1],[66,-37.7],[78.6,38.1]]
Height: the highest point is 44 m above the ground.

3 photographs attached, in order:
  1. wide three-quarter from the south-east access road: long low copper-clad box under palms with the twisted observation tower behind, blue sky
  2. close side view of the angular copper-clad wall and the sheared, twisting tower rising behind it, daylight
  3. front three-quarter from the street: low copper-clad volume with the tall twisted tower behind, palms in front, blue sky

Reply with the JSON object only.

json.notes: The de Young is a long, low, nearly windowless copper-clad box spanning the footprint, with a tall, sheared, stepped copper tower rising behind it toward the back-right. The tower overhangs toward the viewer and is the signature feature to model. A paved entrance forecourt lies in front on the street side.
